claim_summary: Cast-R1 learns a feedback-conditioned forecasting policy with supervised fine-tuning and curriculum-based multi-turn reinforcement learning, supported by diagnostic tools and a memory-backed forecasting workflow.

claim_evidence.quote:
Conditioned on the updated state, Cast-R1 performs adaptive
model selection by invoking one of several forecasting models exposed as tools.

• We develop a two-stage learning strategy that combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-turn reinforcement learning
to train long-horizon forecasting policies.

notes: The fixed three-stage scaffold still conditions model selection and refinement on returned diagnostics and forecasts. Memory is TSK because the detailed implementation is tied to forecast-result availability and forecasting stages. The analytical toolkit is GTS; predictive model integration belongs to the TSK workflow, and unchanged forecasters are not standalone contributions. Process evidence is a qualitative execution case, not a tool-success benchmark. Declared look-back/horizon lengths and raw-scale MSE/MAE do not establish a chronological split or information-availability audit. No downstream decision utility is evaluated.
